rows.title: Press Release
rows.summary: CG Power and Industrial Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated September 04, 2026, titled "CG strengthens India s power infrastructure manufacturing capabilities with the roll out of first transformer from India s largest transformer manufacturing facility at Sehore, Madhya Pradesh ".

rows.title: Appointment
rows.summary: CG Power and Industrial Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of Mr Samit Khanna as Other of the company w.e.f. September 01, 2026.
